description: Sensor HAL, siren (MANUAL-ONLY), and the two role behaviors wired into main dispatch. Depends on FEAT-002 (ews_packet, lora, mqtt) and FEAT-001 (config, pinout). NODE reads enabled sensors and publishes directly over WiFi/MQTT if available else sends a compact LoRa DATA packet; GATEWAY receives LoRa, expands compact->fat JSON, publishes MQTT, tracks last_seen for node-missing detection, and handles siren/cmd. Siren relay is driven ONLY by MQTT command, NEVER by sensor data.
steps: Write include/sensors.h + src/sensors.cpp: a Reading struct and readEnabled(Reading&) that reads ONLY config-enabled sensors: BME280 (Adafruit, 0x76) -> temp/hum/press; ADS1115 (0x48) AIN0 battery V + AIN1 PV V with divider math; EPEVER over RS485 (ModbusMaster, RS485_DERE_PIN direction control, Tracer registers batt V 0x3104 / PV V 0x3100 / SOC 0x311A) -> soc + voltages; rain (GPIO33) and anemometer (GPIO32) pulse counters via attachInterrupt ISRs (pull-up); MQ-135 analogRead(GPIO35); GPS via TinyGPSPlus on Serial1(GPS_RX_PIN,GPS_TX_PIN) -> lat/lon/fix. Guard every reader behind its Config.sensors flag.

Write include/siren.h + src/siren.cpp: tiny inline MCP23017 I2C register helper (write GPIOA/B, set direction) to drive LEDs (power/lora/alarm/fault) and the siren relay (GPA4). setSiren(bool) + handleCmd(const String& cmd) parsing 'ON'|'OFF'|'PATTERN:<name>'. PROMINENT top-of-file comment: SIREN IS MANUAL-ONLY — the relay is actuated ONLY from an MQTT siren/cmd; NEVER call setSiren() from sensor/threshold code. No code path from readEnabled()/thresholds to the relay.

Write include/node.h + src/node.cpp: Node::setup() sends a JOIN packet (identity + active-sensor list) over LoRa; Node::loop() every Config.sensors.intervalSec reads enabled sensors, builds the FAT JSON with ArduinoJson (only enabled groups; mirror firmware-experiment field mapping id/provinsi/kabupaten/kecamatan/ts/seq/weather/power/health), and if WiFi+MQTT connected publishData() directly, else builds a compact DATA packet via ews_packet and LoRa-transmits to the gateway. Thresholds may publish an alarm JSON but MUST NOT touch the siren.

Write include/gateway.h + src/gateway.cpp: Gateway::setup() subscribes siren/cmd and publishes status online; Gateway::loop() polls LoRa receive(): on JOIN register node in a last_seen/metadata table; on DATA expand compact short keys -> fat MQTT JSON (fill kabupaten/kecamatan from packet, else JOIN table), add health{rssi,snr,uptime,fw}, publishData(); periodically if now-last_seen[node] > Config.siren.missThresholdSec publish that node status 'offline' retained (and optional alarm), publish 'online' when heard again. MQTT siren/cmd callback -> siren.handleCmd() + publishSirenState().

Update src/main.cpp role dispatch: in STA mode, construct MQTT, and by Config.identity.role (0=NODE,1=GATEWAY; jumper IGNORED) call Node::setup/loop or Gateway::setup/loop. LoRa init always; MQTT connect only when WiFi up; in AP mode skip role logic (web config handles it in FEAT-004).
Run the build and fix any errors until green.
acceptance_criteria: readEnabled() reads a sensor ONLY when its Config.sensors flag is true.
No code path exists from sensor readings or thresholds to the siren relay; the relay is set only inside the MQTT siren/cmd handler. The MANUAL-ONLY comment is present at the top of src/siren.cpp.
Gateway expands a compact DATA packet into the fat MQTT JSON and tracks last_seen per node_id with a missThreshold offline/online transition.
Node publishes directly over MQTT when WiFi is up and falls back to a compact LoRa DATA packet otherwise.
`python -m platformio run -e ttgo-t-beam-ews` compiles with 0 errors; the single firmware links BOTH roles.
verification: python -m platformio run -e ttgo-t-beam-ews -d c:\aws-kiro\EWS_YG2UFH\.worktrees\ews-firmware\firmware  -> SUCCESS, 0 errors.
findings: DONE, BUILD GREEN. sensors.cpp: every reader gated behind its Config.sensors flag (BME280/ADS1115/EPEVER-Modbus/rain+anemo ISRs/MQ-135/GPS); readEnabled() sets per-group present flags. siren.cpp: MANUAL-ONLY banner; setSiren() reached only via handleCmd(), invoked only by the MQTT siren/cmd callback — no sensor/threshold path, relay starts de-energized. node.cpp: JOIN on boot, then every intervalSec publishes fat JSON over MQTT when WiFi+MQTT up else compact DATA over LoRa; fat JSON + packets carry provinsi/kabupaten/kecamatan/kelurahan. gateway.cpp: LoRa RX -> expand compact->fat JSON (kelurahan carried through, packet value or JOIN-table fallback) -> publish to the node's data topic; last_seen per node with missThresholdSec offline/online transitions; relays per-node siren/cmd -> Siren_Utils::handleCmd + siren/state. main.cpp dispatches Node/Gateway by Config.identity.role (jumper ignored). Re-verified in the convergence pass: SUCCESS, 0 errors.
